5.4 ECU State Manager
The following services primitives of the FrTp module are called by the ECU State Manager module ([SWS_EcuM_02859]): FrTp_Init By this API service primitive, the FrTp module is initialized. FrTp_Shutdown By this API service primitive, all active communication links are closed, resources are freed and the module is stopped.
